data.title: 波岛出海 · 晨曦微光里的软萌依恋早安
data.description: 清晨的暖阳洒在凌乱的白床单上。出海像只树袋熊一样双手双脚紧紧缠在你的腰上，双马尾散乱，小脸枕在你的颈窝里，带着做完美梦后的极甜笑容，含糊地嘟囔着“前辈最喜欢了”。
data.location: bright warm morning bedroom with white rumpled duvet
data.action: 出海像只树袋熊一样双手双脚紧紧缠在你的腰上，双马尾散乱，小脸枕在你的颈窝里
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.promptProse: Bathed in warm morning sunlight pouring across rumpled white sheets, Izumi wraps both arms and legs affectionately around her partner with her cheek nestled into his collarbone and a blissful, drowsy smile.
data.animaCaption: Clinging tightly around her partner's waist like a sleepy koala across the sunlit white bedsheets, she buries her smiling face into the crook of his neck wearing her pink-and-white striped cotton camisole and boy-shorts.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her soft pink-and-white striped ribbed cotton camisole slipped slightly at the shoulder with matching boy-shorts and bare sunlit thighs tangled in the sheets.
